notes.title: New Update v1.4!
notes.notes:
[b]We've updated our game.[/b]
Enhanced visuals and optimization. Fixed several bugs.

We've also added 7 new languages (interface and subtitles):
[list]
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese
[*] Polish
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Japanese
[/list]

notes.title: The release of the game will take place on November 17!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43152841/5dc360ce0b19902300c84ddda30c9903511c298f.jpg[/img]

We invite you to immerse yourself in the tropical climate of the Caribbean Sea on these cold autumn days. A fun story adventure awaits you for 1-2 evenings.
You have to be in the shoes of a simple guy who just wanted to swim to Death Island on his day off to dispel the ashes of his friend Doni.
